At the top left, a small circular avatar of a male cartoon character is positioned next to the brand name '維思維' in black text. In the center, large, bold red vertical text '哎呀' is displayed above a white circular icon of a disappointed, sweating cartoon face. A red rectangular bar at the bottom contains white horizontal text instructions. (2) The central vertical text abruptly changes to '中吉' in red, indicating a shift in fortune. The circular cartoon bubble is replaced by a three-dimensional yellow Maneki-neko (lucky cat) figure wearing a red bib and a gold coin, with its left paw raised in a continuous waving motion. A white speech bubble next to the cat displays a positive greeting. The composition is brightly lit with flat, even animation lighting and no camera movement.
